title: Distance, Displacement, Speed and Velocity
summary: Scalars and vectors: how far you went versus where you ended up, and speed versus velocity.

ib.note: Scalars and vectors are MYP 4 Physics

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 4: Describing Motion Around Us

objectives: I can distinguish scalars from vectors.
I can calculate distance, displacement, average speed and average velocity.
I can explain why displacement can be zero when distance is not.
misconceptions: Distance and displacement are always equal.
Velocity is just another word for speed.
Displacement can't be zero if you moved.
